questions.questionTextEn: What about the Chinook winds over the Central plains of the United state what effect?
questions.questionTextHi: [Jharkhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2013] What about the Chinook winds over the Central plains of the United state what effect?
optionsEn: There is no effect on temperature.
optionsHi: There is no effect on temperature.
questions.explanationEn: Correct Answer: (A) The temperature of winter increases.. The meaning of 'Chinook' is 'Snow Eater'. It is a warm and dry wind descending along the eastern slopes of the Rocky Mountains, blowing from the southern part of Colorado in the South of British Columbia in Canada in the north. Due to its effects, the temperature of summer increases and snow melts and green grass grows even in winter. [Jharkhand P.C.S. (Pre) 2013]
